title: Horizontal Stretch of a Semicircle Graph
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Give an equation for the graph of y = sqrt(4 - x^2) after it is stretched horizontally by a factor of 2.

steps.title: Recall the Horizontal Stretch Rule
steps.explanation: To stretch a graph horizontally by a factor of c > 1, replace x with x / c.
steps.why: Replacing x with x/c multiplies all x-coordinates on the graph by c.

steps.title: Replace x with x / 2 in y = sqrt(4 - x^2)
steps.explanation: Substituting x/2 for x and squaring gives y = sqrt(4 - x^2 / 4).

steps.title: Interpret the Stretched Domain and Geometry
steps.explanation: The original upper semicircle of radius 2 on [-2, 2] is stretched horizontally into an upper semi-ellipse on [-4, 4] with height 2 at (0, 2).
steps.why: Stretching [-2, 2] horizontally by a factor of 2 doubles the domain to [-4, 4].
